GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH
ABSTRACT

Public Services - Andhra Pradesh State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996 -
Implementation of three percent (3%) horizontal reservation to meritorious
sportspersons in Direct Recruitment across Government Departments, Local
Bodies, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) and Uniformed Services including
the Police, Excise and Forest Departments, etc.- Amendment - Orders – Issued.

## GENERAL ADMINISTRATION (SERVICES-D) DEPARTMENT

G.O.Ms.No. 56

Dated:15th May, 2026
Read the following:-

1. Andhra Pradesh State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, as
amended from time to time.
2. G.O.Ms.No.04, YAT&C (Sports & Youth Services) Department,
Dated:19.04.2025.
3. G.O.Ms.No.47, Gen.Admn. (Ser.D) Dept., dated 19th April, 2025.
4. G.O.Ms.No.25,YAT&C (Sports & Youth Services) Department,
Dated: 15.05.2026.
5. From the Secretary, A.P. Public Service Commission,
Vijayawada, Letter No. 115/R&R/2025 Dated:15.05.2026.

******

## ORDER:

In the G.O. second read above, Government in YAT&C Department have
issued orders for implementation of three percent (3%) horizontal reservation
for eligible meritorious sportspersons of Andhra Pradesh in Direct Recruitment
without the requirement of competitive examinations, in Direct Recruitment
across Government Departments, Local Bodies, Public Sector Undertakings
(PSUs) and Uniformed Services including the Police, Excise and Forest
Departments and guidelines were also issued accordingly.

2. Accordingly, necessary amendments have been issued vide reference
third read above to Andhra Pradesh State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996
issued in G.O.Ms.No.436, General Administration (Services-D) Department,
dated the 15ᵗʰ October, 1996 as subsequently amended from time to time.

3.    In the reference fourth read above, Government in YAT& C Department
in supersession of the orders issued in the reference 2ⁿᵈ read above have issued
revised guidelines for implementation of three percent (3%) horizontal

2

reservation for meritorious sportspersons in Direct Recruitment across
Government Departments, Local Bodies, Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)
and Uniformed Services including the Police, Excise and Forest Departments,
etc., who qualify in the prescribed recruitment examination conducted by the
recruiting agencies.

4. Keeping in view of the above revised orders/notification issued by the
YAT&C Department, Government after careful examination of the matter have
decided to make necessary amendments to Andhra Pradesh State and
Subordinate Service Rules, 1996.

5. Orders issued in the reference third read above are hereby superseded.

6. Accordingly, the following Notification will be published in the Andhra
Pradesh Gazette:

## NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by the proviso to Article 309 of the
Constitution of India and of all other powers hereunto enabling, the
Governor of Andhra Pradesh, hereby makes the following amendment to the
Andhra Pradesh State and Subordinate Service Rules, 1996, issued in
G.O.Ms.No.436, General Administration (Services-D) Department, dated the
15th October, 1996 as subsequently amended from time to time.

## AMENDMENTS

(i) In the said rules,

(1) In Rule-2, for Definition-(19) "Meritorious Sportsman", the
following shall be substituted, namely:-

(19) **Meritorious Sportsperson:** "Meritorious Sportsperson" means a
sportsperson who has represented the State of Andhra Pradesh or
Country in recognized sports events in a national or international
competition or medal secured in State level Competition or medal
secured in All India Inter- University competitions conducted by the
